_note: Curated corrections to the profiles derived in web/advisor/profiles.py. The derivation reads ability text, parsed ratios and cooldowns; it has no way to know about kit quirks that break the normal relationship between a stat and its value. Only add an entry when the derived value is WRONG, not merely when it is surprising -- an override is a human assertion and every one needs a reason field explaining the evidence.

_schema.combatProfile: any of basicAttackPattern | basicAttackFrequency | spellbladeProcReliability | repeatedOnHitReliance | attackSpeedValue | critValue | mobilityToDamageConversion | healingReliance. Values: none | low | medium | high, except basicAttackPattern: caster | ability-weaving | repeated-attacks | basic-attack-carry | mixed
_schema.scalingProfile: stat -> none | low-incidental | low | medium | high | core. Overrides the derived label for that stat only.
_schema.buildIdentityProfile: reviewed itemisation identity. primaryBuildPath is physical | magic | tank | support; primaryCombatEngine/mainDamageSource explain what actually wins fights; coreStats/secondaryStats guide item selection; approvedBuildPaths are the only trusted paths; forbiddenAnchors reject misleading one-ratio builds; variantRules can require minimumDefensiveItems/minimumPhysicalOrDefenseItems and cap maximumAPItems/maximumADItems.
_schema.alternativePath: optional reviewed credible secondary path with id, label, description and anchorStats. Its presence allows the legacy offmeta storage key to be generated as Alternative Path; absence means omit that variant.
_schema.abilityDataCorrections: slot -> corrected fields. Only provable scrape artifacts belong here; raw source data remains unchanged and the correction is surfaced in diagnostics.
_schema.reason: why the derivation is wrong here. Required.

_buildIdentityNote: buildIdentity overrides the derived AD/AP itemisation identity for the exceptions the class+scalesWith rule cannot catch: AP bruisers/tanks whose kit also carries an AD ratio, so scalesWith contains 'ad' yet they build full AP.
_rangeProfileNote: rangeProfile ('melee'|'ranged'|'hybrid') is curated because the scrape carries no attack-range field. It gates the Poke variant and ranged-only items. 'hybrid' means the champion has BOTH a melee and a ranged mode in the kit (Gnar transforms, Jayce swaps weapon). Ranged-only items require PURE ranged: a champion who spends any of the game in melee cannot rely on an item that stops working there, so hybrid is treated as melee for items. Default when absent: Marksman/Mage/Enchanter are ranged, everyone else melee. Only exceptions are listed here.

Akali.reason: Melee assassin classed as Mage; her ranged Q is all-in setup, not repeatable safe poke.

Akshan.reason: Ranged basic attacks from his pistol crossbow; no melee mode in the kit.

Diana.reason: Melee diver classed as Mage; ranged Q is engage setup, not poke.

buildIdentityProfile.primaryCombatEngine: Use Lunge and empowered attacks to repeatedly strike Vitals, converting bonus AD into true damage and sustain.
buildIdentityProfile.mainDamageSource: Vital procs, Lunge and repeated AD basic attacks; Riposte's AP ratio is defensive utility and one occasional hit.

alternativePath.label: Crit Duelist
alternativePath.description: A physical crit path supported by Bladework's attack sequence and Lunge applying on-hit effects; it must remain an AD duelist rather than AP novelty.

Fiora.reason: Riposte has a 100% AP ratio but is neither Fiora's repeatable damage engine nor a reason to buy AP. Vitals, Q and attacks define her itemisation; crit is the only credible distinct alternative.

Galio.reason: AP tank/support: his Q/E/R all scale with AP and he is itemised AP, but a stray AD ratio and his Tank class made the class+scalesWith rule read him as AD.

Gnar.reason: Mini Gnar attacks at range, Mega Gnar in melee. Ranged-only items stop working the moment he transforms, so they are withheld.

Gragas.reason: Melee Mage. Barrel is thrown, but his damage pattern is engage and body-slam, not ranged pressure.

Graves.reason: Reload/magazine kit: his damage is governed by shells and reload time, not by attacks per second, so raw attack speed converts far worse for him than the basic-attack-carry pattern implies. This is the same stance the advisor's system prompt already takes ('attack-speed runes are wasted on a reload/magazine kit like Graves').

Gwen.reason: AP bruiser/skirmisher; builds AP despite a bruiser class and a small AD ratio.

buildIdentityProfile.primaryCombatEngine: Stack Ionian Fervor with abilities, reset Bladesurge, then deal repeated empowered basic-attack damage.
buildIdentityProfile.mainDamageSource: Fully stacked passive attacks plus Bladesurge resets; E and R primarily enable marks, resets and crowd control.

Irelia.reason: The raw ultimate cooldowns contain a fourth stray value (8) after the valid three ranks, which made a once-per-fight AP ultimate look like an eight-second spell. Irelia's repeatable engine is AD/on-hit passive attacks and Q resets.

Jayce.reason: Mercury Cannon is ranged, Mercury Hammer is melee, and he swaps freely. Ranged-only items are dead in hammer form.

Kassadin.reason: Melee anti-mage assassin classed as Mage.

Katarina.reason: Melee reset assassin classed as Mage; no repeatable ranged pressure.

buildIdentityProfile.primaryCombatEngine: Use Highlander's attack speed to trigger Double Strike and Wuju Style repeatedly while attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.
buildIdentityProfile.mainDamageSource: Repeated basic attacks, Double Strike and Wuju Style true damage; Alpha Strike supplies access and can crit.

Master Yi.reason: Master Yi is an on-hit/attack-speed carry despite his Assassin class. Meditate's AP ratio is defensive and flat armor penetration does not amplify Wuju Style's repeated true damage.

Mordekaiser.reason: AP bruiser. His kit carries an AD ratio so scalesWith includes 'ad', but he is itemised full AP; without this override he reads as an AD champion.

buildIdentityProfile.primaryCombatEngine: Farm permanent Siphoning Strike stacks, then repeatedly weave the empowered attack with Spellblade while surviving in melee.
buildIdentityProfile.mainDamageSource: Repeated Siphoning Strike empowered basic attacks and their permanent stacks.

Nasus.reason: Nasus's scrape exposes AP ratios but misses the permanent Q stacking engine because it is flat stacking rather than a printed AD ratio. His build is physical Spellblade plus durability, not AP.

Nilah.reason: Melee Marksman -- the one marksman who attacks in melee range.

buildIdentityProfile.primaryCombatEngine: Create engages with Snowball, absorb focus, repeatedly Consume, and hold enemies in Snowball Barrage for the team.
buildIdentityProfile.mainDamageSource: Base damage and repeated frontline spell casts while surviving; a fully channelled ultimate is powerful but interruptible and not the default damage loop.

alternativePath.label: AP Burst
alternativePath.description: A genuine AP burst path using Snowball and Absolute Zero ratios, accepting lower reliability when channels are interrupted.

Nunu & Willump.reason: Nunu has real AP ratios and can support a distinct AP burst path, but the reliable standard identity is an engage/control tank. Full AP belongs only in the explicitly marked Alternative Path.

buildIdentityProfile.primaryCombatEngine: Taunt forces repeated attacks into Defensive Ball Curl, whose retaliation scales with Armor.
buildIdentityProfile.mainDamageSource: Repeated armor-scaled Spiked Shell retaliation during Defensive Ball Curl, not the one-time AP ratio on Powerball.

Rammus.reason: Rammus deals magic damage, but AP does not define his build. His repeatable damage and durability both come from Armor through Defensive Ball Curl and forced enemy attacks through Taunt.

Rumble.reason: Melee Mage. Flamespitter is a short cone applied from melee range.

Urgot.reason: Fires projectiles from range; no melee mode in the kit.
